PR Summary by Qodo

Add review-record validation, merge gate, and guarded merge command ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation ⚙️ Configuration changes 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add review records and a gate that checks coverage, dispositions, CI, and sensitive paths.
>• Require a passing gate and checked head SHA before recording merge intent and merging.
>• Expand merge-hold defaults and test review parsing, gate verdicts, and merge failures.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD A["PR head"] --> B["Lead lease"] --> C["Review records"] --> D["State and room"] --> E["CI and holds"] --> F{"Gate verdict"} -->|PASS| G["Merge intent"] --> H["GitHub merge"] ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Rely on GitHub branch protection for CI
- ➕ Reduces custom check-status handling and maintenance. - ➖ Does not enforce cold or Qodo dispositions, review coverage, ledger entries, or room decisions. - ➖ Required protections may be unavailable for some repositories.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the integrated gate because the review and owner-decision rules extend beyond GitHub's native protections. Use branch protection as an additional safeguard where available, not a replacement for the SHA-bound gate.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
